summary: The Federal Home Loan Bank of San Francisco filed Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that its board is no longer seeking a permanent CEO, as Interim President and CEO Winthrop Watson has agreed to continue indefinitely under the terms of his existing January 7, 2026 employment agreement with no amendments. The decision follows board discussions and Mr. Watson's willingness to serve long-term, citing his leadership and prior FHLBank CEO experience. No deal terms, price, premium, or shareholder vote apply. This is a routine board governance update with no special-situations transaction or structural change, thus classified as None.
